name: partnerships-ops
description: Partner, channel, and ecosystem marketing for B2B SaaS, and the design of the partner program itself. Use for co-marketing with technology alliances and channel partners, integration launches, joint campaigns, partner tiering and enablement, cloud-marketplace go-to-market (AWS, Azure, GCP listings, private offers), and channel program architecture: whether to launch a partner program, which motions to run (referral, technology, services/SI, reseller), partner economics, margin and SPIF design, recruitment and certification, and rules of engagement for a contested deal. Also triggers on: partner marketing, co-marketing, reseller, VAR, MSP, OEM, alliance, ecosystem, AWS Marketplace, MDF, joint webinar, channel conflict, deal registration, should we build a partner program, partner P&L, partner CAC, partner onboarding, partner tiers, our partners signed up and never sold anything.
